title: Wire the compounding loop
intro: A wealth creator is a loop, not a list of traits. Build the loop — and resist the tempting parts that break it.
briefing: Wire profits into the flywheel that makes a decades-long compounder: reinvestment deepens the moat, the moat protects earnings growth, and growth feeds back into profits. The tray also holds two parts that FEEL like growth — the inspector rejects any blueprint that uses them.

rules.label: Growth feeds back into profits — the loop closes
No unrelated diversification in the core loop
No debt-fuelled growth propping up the flywheel

debrief: The structure you wired is the moat J-curve as a machine: profits → reinvestment → moat → earnings → profits, going around for years. The two forbidden parts are the classic loop-breakers — unrelated diversification scatters the reinvestment that should deepen the advantage, and debt-fuelled expansion fakes the growth leg until interest overwhelms earnings (the Reliance Naval pattern: ROCE turns negative and the stock follows). Capital allocation isn't a virtue on the side; it IS the wiring.
